repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-call-ai-summary
repository.purpose: A Webex internal plugin for AI-generated call summary retrieval. Resolves a Pragya container for a call, fetches AI Bridge summary, notes, action-item, and transcript content, and returns it decrypted through the Webex KMS encryption plugin.

glossary.definition: A Pragya-owned record grouping the AI artifacts for one call, addressed by containerId.
glossary.notes: Distinct from a Janus call session, which supplies the container ID.

glossary.definition: The AI container service that resolves container IDs into content URLs and an encryption key.
The service behind summaryUrl, notesUrl, actionItemsUrl, and transcriptUrl that serves encrypted content.
glossary.notes: Addressed only by absolute URLs returned by Pragya; never resolved through the service catalog.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add service discovery for summary content URLs.
negative_guidance.why: Pragya returns region-correct absolute URLs; a second mechanism could disagree.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add test fixtures under test/unit/data/.
negative_guidance.why: Jest collects test/unit/** excluding only lib and fixture, so a data/ directory is picked up as a test suite and fails. Fixtures belong in test/unit/fixture/.
